basis: CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, §7.1: each named area maps to its rectangular line range.
CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, §7.2: item placement by a named area uses the matching row and column lines.
CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, §§11.4–11.7: intrinsic tracks size from item contributions, with spanning contributions distributed across the spanned tracks.

checks: label and value occupy the first row in their named areas
footer occupies the second row and spans both explicit columns
min-content column is sized by the smallest unbreakable word in label
label occupies the minmax(min-content,max-content) first column
value occupies the remaining minmax(0,1fr) column
footer spans both columns without changing the area map
wide occupies the rectangular wide area spanning the first two min-content columns
tail occupies only the third column
empty left and middle areas expose the first and second intrinsic column boundaries
foot occupies only the third column without contributing intrinsic text size
the spanning intrinsic contribution is distributed across the two columns in its area
head and body occupy separate named rows
their min-content and max-content row sizes differ with the fixed 32px inline size

oracleSeparation: Chrome geometry is recorded separately in chrome156-observation.json. The invariants above are the independent expectations used to interpret that observation; browser-derived font advances are not claimed to be independent measurements.
